title: Omission from an intended authoritative account after direct notice
short: The aggravation is not simply that the Protest is missing. It is that the patient identified unfinished neurological work before closure, the clinician proceeded without reopening it, and the final synthesis omitted that event while making the resulting partition portable.
proposition: The treating neurologist received direct notice that the patient considered the neurological work incomplete because the feet had not been properly dealt with. The answer was Podiatry; no neurological reopening or defined handover question is identified. The synthesis then constructed a separate/peripheral-neuropathy/Podiatry channel, preserved separation-compatible patient-state material, and omitted the event that exposed the phenotype as unfinished. Because that synthesis became the portable historical account and later acquired evidential authority, the omission materially altered the represented decision process.

parts.title: Direct notice of unfinished work
parts.statement: The Protest did not convert an already-recognised unresolved relationship into contested uncertainty. It forced an incompletely examined part of the phenotype back into view before closure.

parts.title: Decision after notice
parts.statement: The neurologist answered Podiatry; the record identifies no neurological reopening and no defined neurological handover question or return mechanism. Before the Protest the problem may be omission; after the Protest it becomes decision.

parts.title: Documentary partition
parts.statement: The synthesis then allocated the painful feet to a separate/peripheral-neuropathy/Podiatry channel ending 'Not clear', while strengthening 'markedly divorced'.

parts.title: Directional selection
parts.statement: Separation-compatible patient-state material travelled while the patient's warning that the phenotype was unfinished did not.

parts.title: Later evidential authority
parts.statement: The resulting documentary history was later invoked as evidence of reasoning and shared understanding when the historical pathway was challenged.

asymmetry: the patient-state compatible with separation travelled; the patient-state identifying unfinished work did not.
self_protecting_effect: the event capable of showing that the founding pathway required reconsideration was absent from the founding account later relied upon as evidence of continuity and adequate reasoning.
